description: Check triage states plainly that a check has never passed, and does not treat it as a regression.
failure_mode: Model assumes a known-good state and starts looking for what changed — bisecting a history in which nothing was ever different.
prompt: You are triaging the failing check "E2E Sweep" in owner/app. `nightgauge ci history --workflow e2e.yml --limit 100 --json` returns {"ever_passed": false, "examined": 34, "consecutive_failures": 34, "first_run": {"created_at": "2026-07-28T02:00:00Z"}}. What do you conclude and what do you do next?

assertions.pattern: (never passed|never been green|no passing run|never succeeded)
assertions.description: states the check has never been green

assertions.pattern: (not a regression|no regression|isn't a regression|is not a regression)
assertions.description: refuses the regression framing outright — a substring ban cannot tell 'I will not bisect' from 'I will bisect', so the discriminator has to be the correct statement, not the absence of the wrong word

assertions.pattern: (no known.good|nothing to compare|no baseline|broken since it was added)
assertions.description: names the consequence: there is no known-good state to diff against
